summary: Microsoft-ABI mangling leaves out C++20 module attachment, so a module-linkage function and a global function of the same name link as duplicates

toolchain: GCC / libstdc++ off Linux (macOS, Windows MinGW, FreeBSD)
summary: std::call_once with a callable that throws doesn't leave the flag unset for a retry
-frounding-math doesn't stop all constant folding, so rounding-mode changes can be ignored (the cfenv page notes it)
std::nested_exception doesn't capture current_exception(), so std::rethrow_if_nested would terminate
defines __cpp_range_based_for as 202211L (P2718) but destroys the temporary in for (int x : Holder{{1, 2, 3}}.items()) before the loop runs, so the loop reads a destroyed vector
rejects a constexpr virtual call through a base reference (C2131; valid since C++20, P1064) and a call inside if consteval (C7595; C++23, P1938); VS 2026 (19.51) accepts both
#embed in a braced list counts as one element when deducing std::initializer_list (auto il = { #embed ... }), failing with 'excess elements in array initializer'; fixed in Clang 21

libstdc++'s std::forward_like has a deduced return type that Clang, treating it as a builtin, can't use, so calling a bind_front/bind_back result and piping into ranges::to<C>() fail on libstdc++'s deducing-this path; fixed in libstdc++ 14.3
Clang doesn't constant-evaluate arithmetic on GNU __complex__ types, so constexpr std::complex arithmetic from libstdc++ is rejected

every format string with a dynamic width or precision ("{:{}}") is rejected at compile time in C++26 mode: Clang can't call __check_dynamic_spec, instantiated before its definition (llvm#73232); libstdc++ works around it in 15.4 and 16.3
a type whose formatter's format() takes std::format_context& (not a template context) isn't treated as formattable, so std::format/std::print with it fails to compile; libc++ 19 accepts it
internal compiler error (segfault) compiling every named-module unit; the same GCC 14.2.0 on FreeBSD 14.5 builds them
match: internal compiler error \(segfault\) on every module unit

summary: std::ranges::contains over views::join of a built-in 2-D array returns true for a value that isn't there; libc++ 21 and libstdc++ are correct
